title: Lease

validation.research: Five primary sources: Unmesh Joshi’s Lease catalog, official etcd Lease API and Microsoft Blob lease documentation, Mike Burrows’s Chubby paper (sections 2.8–2.9), and Martin Kleppmann’s fencing discussion. The singular established name has no required alias. Grant identity, scoped rights, atomic acquisition and release, authority timing, conservative client timers, uncertain renewal outcomes, failover preservation, and destination enforcement are distinguished. etcd attachment alone is not an exclusive acquisition; Azure expired-lease renewal semantics differ from the deliberately stricter teaching model. A cache TTL is not automatically a coordinating agreement, and expiry does not stop a process or delayed external I/O.

runnable_example.verification: Exact six-line demo output; renewal at 2000 ms resets deadline to 5000 rather than adding to the old deadline; B is denied at 4999 and A cannot renew or release at exactly 5000; replacement B survives obsolete A renewals/releases; explicit release permits immediate C acquisition; reused worker names receive distinct acquisition identities; frozen Grant values; exact 1/60000 ms TTL bounds; renewal from acceptance time including deliberate shortening; zero and huge forward time advances; invalid TTL, owner and time inputs preserve all state; no-grant and wrong-acquisition operations reject without mutation; all 4096 four-step traces over eight operations satisfy atomic acquisition, renewal, release, nondecreasing time and identity invariants; independent model instances. Trusted single-scope sequential in-memory model only, with no real clock, network, client timer, persistence, authentication, failover, automatic cancellation, external writes, or destination fencing inferred.

example_limits: Original Python 3.11+ deterministic sequential in-memory authority model for one exclusive partition. One manually advanced nondecreasing integer-millisecond clock defines expiry; TTLs are 1–60000 ms and validity requires time strictly before the deadline. Method calls model atomic authority operations. Trusted immutable Grant values identify an acquisition within that single scope, not security credentials. Acquisition IDs are increasing in this model but are not consumed as destination fences. Renewal resets expiry from acceptance time and may deliberately shorten it; renewal and release at or after expiry are disallowed even if no replacement exists. Reusing an owner name does not reuse its acquisition identity. No real clock, independent client timer, RPC, storage, durable monotonic state, coordinator failover, authentication, automatic cancellation, external write, or destination fencing implementation is inferred. All 4096 four-step traces over eight operations check this bounded sequential lifecycle rather than real thread or network interleavings.
